```sql
SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(pts) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN played = 1 THEN game_id END) AS games_played
FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats"
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', game_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2016 AND 2017
  AND player_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY player_id, player_name
ORDER BY total_points DESC, player_name ASC
LIMIT 5
```
